Lock-only promotion of BenchBox to Theseus release A, following the existing promotion procedure (as for v0.2.8: .github/theseus-lock.json version, source_commit, workflow_sha, source_sha256, delta_sha256 from the then-current lock, artifact sha256 and both URLs; the same SHA in `uses:` and `with.theseus_ref` of .github/workflows/review-gate.yml and review-verdict.yml; changelog fragment).
Start check (recorded here before work): no other open BenchBox PR changes .github/theseus-lock.json or the review callers (the adoption PR for benchbox-adopt-theseus-v025-review-guidance-20261107 changes review-verdict.yml); PR #4062 is merged or closed (state recorded). If #4062 has not merged, this promotion must carry its oracle-gate cutover (ruleset, ruleset_review_enforcement.py, caller CONTEXTS, repo-admin-settings.md), and oracle-gate is removed from the live ruleset first with before/after captures (settings authority granted to the coordinator).
Before promoting, confirm BenchBox does not parse any review-verdict or review-gate status description text that release A changed (rg across scripts/, _project/scripts/, tools/, make/, .github/); if one does, migrate it in this PR with tests.
Guardrails: BenchBox AGENTS.md write workflow; recompute and verify every lock value independently (download both wheels and hash them); never weaken a required check; hosted SHIP on the final head; arm via make pr-arm; no live model calls.
